scenes.headline: How Poolside's factory builds a model in five weeks
scenes.sub: Laguna M.1 and XS.2, and the versioned loop that made them.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Cypress! Poolside's Laguna report ships two coding models, but its real subject is the factory that built them.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Model building as an industrial process: one versioned loop of data, training, evaluation and inference, where a win ships by flipping a flag.
scenes.say: The idea: treat model building as an industrial process. Data, training, evaluation and inference form one versioned loop, and a research win ships by flipping a flag.

scenes.title: One loop: data, train, evaluate, serve

steps.say: Hive generates synthetic data. Blender streams the data mix, and Titan trains on it.
Atlas serves inference and RL rollouts, reading Titan's model definitions bit for bit. What you evaluate is what you serve.
One code execution platform, spanning about a million repositories, supplies synthetic tasks, runs the evals and scores the RL rewards.

steps.note: every run: committed config, unique ID
steps.say: Every run is committed code with its own ID. So any checkpoint, or even one training token, traces back to its source.

scenes.title: AutoMixer: the data mix, by optimization
scenes.say: Even the data mix is automated. AutoMixer turns a matter of taste into a search.

items.say: Sample mixtures from more than fifty dataset groups, staying near a hand-made prior.
Train about sixty small proxy models, one per mixture.
Score each one on coding, math, knowledge and more.
Fit a regressor per capability, predicting scores from the mixture.
Then optimize the mixture, weighting the capabilities you care about.

scenes.label: from inception to release for XS.2, built from scratch
scenes.say: The evidence: they built the smaller model from scratch, inception to release, in five weeks.

scenes.text: The report's bet: iteration speed, not an architecture trick, is the lever. The factory makes the second model boring.
scenes.say: The report's bet is that iteration speed, not an architecture trick, is the lever. The factory's job is to make the second model boring.

recap: One versioned loop: data, train, evaluate, serve
Research ships to production by a flag
AutoMixer picks the data mix by optimization
scenes.say: To recap: one versioned loop, research that ships by a flag, and a data mix chosen by an optimizer.
